title: 35 Traditional Tangkhul Naga Proverbs & Idiomatic Maxims (Paocham / Paotam)
hindi_title: तंगखुल नागा ३५ पारम्परिक लोकोक्तियाँ, मुहावरे एवं नीति-वचन संग्रह
source: Rev. William Pettigrew (1918) & Tangkhul Elders Folklore Documentation

proverbs.tangkhul: Ra-chay-li theingui-shai-lu, rit-linga-lung khang-san-lu, kachi katha.
proverbs.literal: Roasting fruit when thirsty, or putting a stone on an already heavy load.
proverbs.english: Applies to a person who adds to his misery by repeated silly actions.
proverbs.hindi: प्यास लगने पर फल भूनना, या भारी बोझ पर पत्थर और लाद देना। (अपनी ही बेवकूफी से अपनी मुसीबत बढ़ाना / आफत मोल लेना।)
proverbs.parallel_english_proverb: Adding fuel to fire / Adding insult to injury

proverbs.tangkhul: Par-ki kaja-na shup-a, shup-ki kaja-na par-a, kachi katha.
proverbs.literal: Closing fist when one ought to open it, and opening when one ought to close.
proverbs.english: Applies to an ambitious, greedy person who thinks he can get a lot for nothing.
proverbs.hindi: जब हाथ खोलना चाहिए तब मुट्ठी भींचना, और जब बंद रखना चाहिए तब खोल देना। (लालच में सब कुछ गँवा बैठना / लालच बुरी बला है।)
proverbs.parallel_english_proverb: Covetousness over-reacheth itself

proverbs.tangkhul: Khamatha sa-gi ji-la fa nga-sa-thui-ho-wa, kachi katha.
proverbs.literal: Intending to do something good, but turning it into a complete mess.
proverbs.english: Applies to one who is unfortunate in any attempt to do something good.
proverbs.hindi: अच्छा करने चले थे पर काम और बिगड़ गया। (चौबे जी गए थे छब्बे बनने, दुबे बन कर आए।)
proverbs.parallel_english_proverb: The road to hell is paved with good intentions

proverbs.tangkhul: Nga-ley-a-kha shi-ley-tha, nga-yur-a-kha nga-wur tha, yay-a-kha nga-yay tha, kachi katha.
proverbs.literal: Unity is like wasps' nest on rock; discord is like moles' nest; shallowness is like a sieve.
proverbs.english: United we stand strong as a rock; divided we collapse like dry loam.
proverbs.hindi: एकता चट्टान पर बने ततैयों के छत्ते जैसी अटूट होती है; फूट पड़ने पर वह छछूंदर के बिल जैसी ढह जाती है।
proverbs.parallel_english_proverb: United we stand, divided we fall

proverbs.tangkhul: Tho-rachi-than thri, thai-ra chi-than tho, kachi katha.
proverbs.literal: Expecting feast and starving; expecting nothing and finding abundance.
proverbs.english: Receiving unexpected fortune when least expected, and disappointed when expectant.
proverbs.hindi: जब बहुत उम्मीद थी तब भूखे रहे, और जब कोई आस न थी तब छप्पर फाड़ कर मिला।
proverbs.parallel_english_proverb: Blessed are they that expect nothing, for they shall not be disappointed

proverbs.tangkhul: Mei kachot-li tara phungda kazat, kachi katha.
proverbs.literal: Carrying cold water while running towards a raging wild forest fire.
proverbs.english: Coming well-prepared with peace when tempers flare in clan gatherings.
proverbs.hindi: जंगल की आग बुझाने के लिए ठंडा पानी लेकर दौड़ना। (क्रोध में शांति का मरहम लगाना।)
proverbs.parallel_english_proverb: A soft answer turneth away wrath

proverbs.tangkhul: Lung-kui eina tonda kazat kha pheikhavai makalei, kachi katha.
proverbs.literal: Gliding down steep crags like river eel without arms or feet.
proverbs.english: Overcoming insurmountable natural obstacles through quiet perseverance and adaptability.
proverbs.hindi: बिना हाथ-पैर के भी ऊँची फिसलन भरी चट्टानों से सुरक्षित निकल जाना। (धैर्य और युक्ति से हर बाधा पार करना।)
proverbs.parallel_english_proverb: Where there is a will, there is a way

proverbs.tangkhul: Kaphung terrace-li yarshon-sakashung kha phei eina khon masamana.
proverbs.literal: Bowing low across terrace fields from dawn to dusk without complaining.
proverbs.english: Tireless diligence and quiet hard work bringing forth abundant harvest.
proverbs.hindi: सीढ़ीदार खेतों में भोर से शाम तक बिना उफ किए मेहनत करना। (परिश्रम ही सफलता की कुंजी है।)
proverbs.parallel_english_proverb: Hard work never kills a man / Diligence is the mother of good luck

proverbs.tangkhul: Khamang-tui ror-a-kha lungli chei-thada kapam, kachi katha.
proverbs.literal: A solemn promise once carved stands firmer than iron in mountain granite.
proverbs.english: A man of true honor never breaks his sworn word.
proverbs.hindi: मुँह से निकला वचन पत्थर की लकीर होता है। (प्राण जाए पर वचन न जाए।)
proverbs.parallel_english_proverb: An honest man's word is as good as his bond

proverbs.tangkhul: Ngashunli khangapa, ngaya tharan meira phungkazat, kachi katha.
proverbs.literal: Resting quietly by day, glowing brightly when darkness falls over the ridge.
proverbs.english: A humble and modest person whose true brilliance shines in times of crisis.
proverbs.hindi: दिन में शांत रहकर विपत्ति की रात में मशाल बनकर चमकना। (संकट में ही सच्चे वीर की पहचान होती है।)
proverbs.parallel_english_proverb: Adversity introduces a man to himself

proverbs.tangkhul: Maza khamahon tharan samkui eina phei mashun, kachi katha.
proverbs.literal: Striking the wooden mortar with rhythmic precision when golden paddy is ripe.
proverbs.english: Seizing the opportune moment when circumstances are ripe for harvest.
proverbs.hindi: धान पकते ही सही ताल में मूसल चलाना। (अवसर का लाभ उठाना / मौके पर चौका मारना।)
proverbs.parallel_english_proverb: Strike while the iron is hot

proverbs.tangkhul: Ava-wui ning eina tara kaphung thada ngakhum, kachi katha.
proverbs.literal: A mother's heart is a deep spring that never dries through summer drought.
proverbs.english: Unconditional motherly love and boundless familial devotion.
proverbs.hindi: माँ का स्नेह उस गहरे चश्मे जैसा है जो जेठ की दुपहरी में भी कभी नहीं सूखता।
proverbs.parallel_english_proverb: A mother's love is peace / Blood is thicker than water

proverbs.tangkhul: Minao-na kaphungli zat-la thing-kuisam ma-khat-mana, kachi katha.
proverbs.literal: Walking through high pine woods without disturbing dry fallen needles.
proverbs.english: Living so harmoniously and respectfully with nature that no harm is left behind.
proverbs.hindi: चीड़ के जंगल से इस तरह गुज़रना कि सूखी पत्ती भी न चटके। (प्रकृति के साथ पूर्ण सामंजस्य।)
proverbs.parallel_english_proverb: Leave nothing but footprints, take nothing but memories

proverbs.tangkhul: Sira kachangli khayang-eili phei khurli ngatak, kachi katha.
proverbs.literal: Gazing at the distant stars while stepping blind into the muddy ditch.
proverbs.english: Being so preoccupied with lofty daydreams that one forgets immediate duties.
proverbs.hindi: आसमान के तारे देखते-देखते पैरों के नीचे के गड्ढे में गिर जाना। (हवाई किले बनाना।)
proverbs.parallel_english_proverb: Keep your feet on the ground and your eyes on the stars

proverbs.tangkhul: Khamiyang-wui hamli tara kachui ma-tam-mana, kachi katha.
proverbs.literal: The guest pot in a hospitable home is never dry when a stranger knocks.
proverbs.english: Generous hospitality is the crown jewel of Tangkhul village character.
proverbs.hindi: अतिथि-सत्कार करने वाले के घर की हाँडी कभी खाली नहीं रहती। (अतिथि देवो भव।)
proverbs.parallel_english_proverb: Hospitality makes all men kin

proverbs.tangkhul: Khara-ngashat kakhon eina lami yām-thui-haowa, kachi katha.
proverbs.literal: The single sharp bark of the deer causes the lurking leopard to flee.
proverbs.english: Timely warning from the alert saves the entire community from disaster.
proverbs.hindi: काकड़ की एक तीखी पुकार से घात लगाए तेंदुए को भागना पड़ता है। (समय पर दी गई चेतावनी जान बचाती है।)
proverbs.parallel_english_proverb: Forewarned is forearmed

proverbs.tangkhul: Wung-wui akhonli ngaka kha mashunli zang-ra, kachi katha.
proverbs.literal: Heeding the quiet counsel of village elders keeps one upon the safe mountain trail.
proverbs.english: Respect for ancestral wisdom safeguards the youth from cliffside ruin.
proverbs.hindi: बुजुर्गों की बात मानकर चलने से पथरीले रास्तों पर कभी पैर नहीं फिसलते।
proverbs.parallel_english_proverb: Listen to the elders, for they have traveled the road

proverbs.tangkhul: Fa-kharar-na ngaya rurung-eili chimik kakhaya mathei, kachi katha.
proverbs.literal: The aged hound dozes by the fire, yet hears the softest tread in the yard.
proverbs.english: Old age brings sharpened inner perception and quiet intuition.
proverbs.hindi: बूढ़ा कुत्ता चूल्हे के पास सोता ज़रूर है, पर आँगन की मद्धिम आहट भी सुन लेता है।
proverbs.parallel_english_proverb: There is no fool like an old fool / Experience is the best teacher

proverbs.tangkhul: Khong-kharar kakhong tharan mayarnao saikora ngasot-ser-re, kachi katha.
proverbs.literal: When the great village log drum sounds, all men stand together as one wall.
proverbs.english: In times of collective defense, internal bickering vanishes instantly.
proverbs.hindi: जब गाँव का महा-नगाड़ा बजता है, तब सब मतभेद भूलकर एक दीवार बन जाते हैं।
proverbs.parallel_english_proverb: A common danger unites even foes

proverbs.tangkhul: Shongfa kharar-li kazat-a-kha aphei ma-chot-mana, kachi katha.
proverbs.literal: Walking along the ancient beaten footpath ensures sure feet that never stumble.
proverbs.english: Adhering to proven tradition brings security and peace of mind.
proverbs.hindi: पुरखों की बनी पगडंडी पर चलने से पाँव में कभी काँटा नहीं चुभता।
proverbs.parallel_english_proverb: Do not leave the old road for a new one

proverbs.tangkhul: Rap-kaphungli meikha kashur-thada ning kacham ngachon-ra, kachi katha.
proverbs.literal: Like smoked venison cured above the hearth, patience sweetens character.
proverbs.english: Trials endured with patience temper human character into pure gold.
proverbs.hindi: जैसे मचान पर धुएँ में सूखा माँस सालों चलता है, वैसे ही धैर्य से इंसान परिपक्व होता है।
proverbs.parallel_english_proverb: Patience is bitter, but its fruit is sweet

proverbs.tangkhul: Tangkhul-tui eina laa kasa-kha kaphung chiko ngakhum-ra, kachi katha.
proverbs.literal: Singing in ancestral Tangkhul tongue echoes across nine mountain ridges.
proverbs.english: Preserving one's native language preserves the very soul of the ancestors.
proverbs.hindi: मातृभाषा तंगखुल में गाया गया लोक-गीत नौ पहाड़ियों के पार तक गूँजता है।
proverbs.parallel_english_proverb: A language is the soul of its people

proverbs.tangkhul: Zimik kashung-tharan kachon phunglu, ngazing tharan chabi thumlu, kachi katha.
proverbs.literal: Work while the sun blazes high; lock the gate securely when dusk falls.
proverbs.english: Do all things in their proper season and balance labor with domestic rest.
proverbs.hindi: धूप रहते मेहनत करो, और शाम होते ही घर की अर्गला लगाओ। (समय पर काम और समय पर विश्राम।)
proverbs.parallel_english_proverb: Make hay while the sun shines

proverbs.tangkhul: Meikhu makalei-eili meira ma-ngaphar-mana, kachi katha.
proverbs.literal: Where there is no smoke rising, there can be no crackling campfire.
proverbs.english: Rumors rarely originate without some core grain of truth.
proverbs.hindi: जहाँ धुआँ नहीं, वहाँ आग नहीं हो सकती। (बिना आग के धुआँ नहीं उठता।)
proverbs.parallel_english_proverb: Where there's smoke, there's fire

proverbs.tangkhul: Kharai-kanao-li lungkui khangsan-a-kha kachir kakhai-ra, kachi katha.
proverbs.literal: Packing heavy river stones into a tiny cane basket breaks the bottom through.
proverbs.english: Imposing unbearable responsibilities upon the young or weak causes ruin.
proverbs.hindi: नन्ही टोकरी में भारी पत्थर लादने से उसकी तली फट जाती है। (क्षमता से अधिक बोझ न डालो।)
proverbs.parallel_english_proverb: The last straw breaks the camel's back

proverbs.tangkhul: Hamei makalei-eili khor-tara ma-nganam-mana, kachi katha.
proverbs.literal: Without yeast cake, boiled rice can never turn into fragrant wine.
proverbs.english: Great accomplishments require the catalytic spark of inspiration and effort.
proverbs.hindi: बिना खमीर के चावल कभी मीठी मदिरा में नहीं बदल सकता। (बिना प्रेरणा और प्रयास के सिद्धि नहीं।)
proverbs.parallel_english_proverb: No pain, no gain

proverbs.tangkhul: Pui-kashao eina lung-phei chathat-a-kha pui kakhai-ra, kachi katha.
proverbs.literal: Striking sharp cliff rocks with flexible green bamboo snaps the cane in two.
proverbs.english: Trying to defeat rigid malice with rash anger harms oneself alone.
proverbs.hindi: पत्थर पर बाँस की छड़ी जोर से मारने पर छड़ी ही टूटती है। (क्रोध में अपना ही नुकसान होता है।)
proverbs.parallel_english_proverb: He who spits against the wind spits in his own face

proverbs.tangkhul: Shim-wui yumshang kaphung-thada amei-ngasot-na shim khavai lei, kachi katha.
proverbs.literal: Like the central house pillar holds the roof, loving brotherhood sustains the clan.
proverbs.english: Mutual trust between brothers is the unbreakable support of the family.
proverbs.hindi: जैसे घर का मुख्य खंभा छप्पर थामता है, वैसे ही भाइयों का प्रेम परिवार को जोड़े रखता है।
proverbs.parallel_english_proverb: A brother is a friend given by nature

proverbs.tangkhul: Tara-shongfa-li khangao-eili khorum makalei, kachi katha.
proverbs.literal: Drawing water at the living spring leaves no mud inside the drinking cup.
proverbs.english: Seeking knowledge directly from original ancestral sources keeps the mind clear.
proverbs.hindi: ताज़ा बहते झरने से पानी लेने पर प्याले में कभी कीचड़ नहीं आता। (मूल स्रोतों से ज्ञान पाना।)
proverbs.parallel_english_proverb: Drink from the spring, not the ditch

proverbs.tangkhul: Shirui-wui kashong won-thada kaphā-bing-na kuiphungli phā-ra, kachi katha.
proverbs.literal: Like the Shirui Lily blooming on the summit, genuine virtue cannot be hidden in shadow.
proverbs.english: True noble character is recognized and celebrated far and wide.
proverbs.hindi: शिरुई पर्वत के दुर्लभ फूल की तरह, सच्चा सद्गुण कभी अँधेरे में नहीं छिपता।
proverbs.parallel_english_proverb: A good name is better than precious ointment

proverbs.tangkhul: Chumpha tharan shimkhur khong-eili maza-wui ngachee kathei, kachi katha.
proverbs.literal: When opening the granary at Chumpha, the harvest tells the truth of the year's toil.
proverbs.english: Ultimate results reveal the true quality of past labor and preparation.
proverbs.hindi: कटाई के बाद जब अन्न-भंडार खुलता है, तब साल भर की मेहनत का सच सामने आता है।
proverbs.parallel_english_proverb: By their fruits ye shall know them

proverbs.tangkhul: Lami-kanao-na kuisam ngaphar-la hok-kharam ma-ngachee-mana, kachi katha.
proverbs.literal: A small wildcat spitting fire cannot intimidate a tusker boar.
proverbs.english: Empty bluster and hollow boasts collapse before genuine strength.
proverbs.hindi: छोटी बिल्ली के गुर्राने से जंगली सूअर कभी भयभीत नहीं होता। (खोखली धमकी से काम नहीं चलता।)
proverbs.parallel_english_proverb: Barking dogs seldom bite

proverbs.tangkhul: Thingrong kaphung-wui tarep-thada okathuili thot-thotli mashang, kachi katha.
proverbs.literal: Like deep roots of an ancient banyan holding terrace slopes through centuries.
proverbs.english: Deep ancestral cultural roots keep a people standing through all historic storms.
proverbs.hindi: विशाल वटवृक्ष की गहरी जड़ों की तरह, जो तूफानों में भी धरती को थामे रखती हैं।
proverbs.parallel_english_proverb: A tree with strong roots laughs at storms

proverbs.tangkhul: Amai mashun-eili khon kashok marang, kachi katha.
proverbs.literal: The straight wooden hoe cuts clean without clattering noise.
proverbs.english: A truly competent craftsman works quietly without bragging.
proverbs.hindi: सीधा मजबूत फावड़ा बिना शोर मचाए साफ काम करता है। (योग्य व्यक्ति काम करके दिखाता है, बातें नहीं।)
proverbs.parallel_english_proverb: Still waters run deep / Actions speak louder than words

proverbs.tangkhul: Tangkhul Ram-wui lung-kharar-thada phaning-kacham ngaror-ra, kachi katha.
proverbs.literal: Standing as unyielding as the sacred standing stones of our Tangkhul homeland.
proverbs.english: Uncompromising loyalty to land, people, and truth through all eternity.
proverbs.hindi: तंगखुल मातृभूमि के पवित्र स्मृति-स्तंभों की तरह सत्य और स्वाभिमान पर अडिग रहना।
proverbs.parallel_english_proverb: Firm as a rock in the midst of the sea
